processing.llm_prompt: You are analyzing an image extracted from a document. Transcribe all text exactly as shown. If the image is a diagram, chart, or figure, describe its components, connections, labels, and spatial layout in a structured way. If it contains math or formulas, write them in plain text notation (e.g., E[T_R] = 1/(mu_R - b_R)). Return only the transcription and description, nothing else.
